## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `mailchimp-transactional-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to your Mailchimp account

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Mailchimp account at [login.mailchimp.com](https://login.mailchimp.com/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select your profile icon in the top-right corner to open the account menu. -->

## Step 3: Enable transactional email

1. In the account menu, select **Billing**.
2. Under **Monthly plans or credits**, select **Transactional Email Plan** (you can start with the demo plan).

## Step 4: Generate a Mandrill API key

1. Navigate to the **Extras** section and select **API keys**.
2. Select **Create A Mandrill API Key** (not the regular API key). You are redirected to the MandrillApp dashboard.
3. In the MandrillApp dashboard, select **+ Add API Key** to generate your key.
4. <!-- manual: Copy the generated API key. -->
